Neilsen Grove is a north Ladner pocket in the City of Delta, and the spelling is the first fact: the AREA is "Neilsen Grove" and the SCHOOL is "Neilson Grove Elementary" — opposite spellings, both official
The pocket sits on and around the Marina Garden Estates lands on Admiral Way and Admiral Boulevard, named in City of Delta council reports; the City publishes no neighbourhood boundary for the name
Neilson Grove Elementary is physically in the area at 5500 Admiral Boulevard
Hawthorne is south, Delta Manor and the Ladner village core are south-west, and Ladner Harbour is west, at Ladner Harbour Park, 4905 McNeelys Way
The pocket mixes freehold detached houses with strata townhouse and apartment buildings in the Hampton Cove / Marina Garden Estates development on Admiral Way and Admiral Boulevard

Polygon's Hampton Cove buildings, from the developer's own pages: Pilothouse, a condominium building at 5535 Admiral Way ( Fairwinds townhomes at 5550 Admiral Way ( Beaufort Landing townhomes at 5551 Admiral Way ( and Westhampton townhomes at 5311 Admiral Way
A City council report names Marina Garden Estates at 5311 Admiral Way as a townhouse development, and a City memorandum describes a multi-family apartment building within the same application lands
7600 — RS5 minimum lot area 550 m² (460 m² outside the Single Family Residential designation), RS6 at 390 m² and RS7 at 335 m² for new lots created by subdivision

blocks.text: Neilsen Grove: rules that affect buyers

items.t: The RS1 zone lists a secondary suite as an accessory use to a single detached dwelling, which is the suite route for the pocket's detached lots where RS1 applies

blocks.text: Neilsen Grove: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Ladner Pioneer Library (Fraser Valley Regional Library) is at 4683 51st Street in the village core
SD37 publishes Ladner Area catchment boundary maps (elementary and secondary, updated October 2017) alongside the address-based locator

The pocket-specific point is billing type: urban Ladner homes here are on City water and sewer, billed on the annual flat rate utility bill or quarterly metered bills, unlike the well-and-septic checks that apply on Delta farm parcels
From Ladner Exchange, route 601 runs via Ladner Trunk Road (Highway 10), Highway 17A and Highway 99 to Bridgeport Station on the Canada Line
Route 620 links Ladner Exchange to the BC Ferries Tsawwassen terminal and to Bridgeport Station via Highway 17A and Highway 17

blocks.text: Neilsen Grove: risks and due diligence

items.t: For a Hampton Cove strata unit, the due diligence is the strata record set — bylaws, rules, fees, levies and depreciation information — under the Province's strata buying guidance
Confirm the parcel's flood construction level with the City: Ladner is diked low land, and the level is property-specific

blocks.text: Jared's take on Neilsen Grove, Ladner

By the marina and golf course, Neilsen Grove (the school and the City spell it Neilson Grove) is Ladner’s riverside pocket. Hampton Cove’s townhomes and condos sit between Captain’s Cove Marina and Cove Links, with detached streets and a 55+ community nearby. Neilson Grove Elementary is on Admiral Boulevard, and the Millennium Trail runs to Deas Island Regional Park, so it’s ideal if you want a resort-style, low-maintenance Ladner lifestyle.
